title: Block Parkour Trials
description: Block Parkour Trials is a super fun and free-to-play parkour game. Your goal is to reach the portal at the finish line by skillfully jumping over obstacles. Have fun and enjoy the challenge!

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: Diep.io
description: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon. The aim is simple: move around the map and destroy the other players whilst improving and upgrading your own circle.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Onu Live
description: ONU Live is a classic card multiplayer game that offers endless entertainment for players of all ages.In this strategy card game, the goal is to be the first player to empty their hand of cards before the countdown timer reaches zero.

title: Mine Jump
description: Jump into action! ? Test your logic and reflexes in this addictive game. Collect slugs, upgrade your hero, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious planet! ?✨

title: Hide Me
description: Do you love the thrill of cat and mouse games? Are you ready to outsmart your pursuers and claim victory? Dive into "Hide Me", the latest hide-and-seek adventure that will put your wits and reflexes to the test!

title: Block Blaster Puzzle
description: Aim for high scores or complete level objectives. Rotate and arrange blocks to clear rows and columns while enjoying stunning visuals. Each perfect move brings satisfaction, challenging you to beat your best and master each puzzle!

title: Animal Swipe
description: Animal Swipe is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players match adorable animal pairs on a colorful board. With easy-to-learn controls and exciting power-ups, the game offers a challenge for both casual and strategic players. Use your wits and boosts to clear levels and achieve your objectives!

title: Cityquest
description: Guess the hidden city by using compass directions and unlocking helpful hints like continent, flag, time zone, and name clues.

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing
description: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing plays like a shoot-em-up car shooting arcade game. With 3D vehicles on the ground, your mission is to defeat the final boss by collecting upgrade items and shooting down vehicles on the ground. Your vehicle will keep shooting automatically. Don't forget to collect the magnet to collect all kinds of items easily. To defeat the final boss, you need to avoid its bullets and keep shooting. Have fun!

title: Clash Crowd Game
description: Clash Crowd Game is an addictive arcade runner game where you tap to run, survive obstacles, and reach the destination. Control your crowd, avoid traps, and face thrilling challenges in every level. Easy controls, engaging gameplay, and colorful 3D graphics make this game perfect for quick fun. Run smart, grow your crowd, and prove your survival skills.

title: War Robots Battles
description: Enter the future battlefield, and lead your powerful robots in exciting battles. War Robots Battles lets you feel the most exciting robot action. You can attack with powerful weapons and use strategy to win. Choose your robot, equip powerful weapons, and build the strongest combat team. Choose from wind sword, imperial bow, etc.

title: Sprunki Phase Brainrot
description: Sprunki Phase Brainrot is a chaotic and hilarious reskin of the original Sprunki game, now powered by Italian Brainrot energy! Play as absurd meme legends like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Frigo Camelo, La Vaca Saturno, Lirili Larila, Burbaloni Luliloli, and many more. Run, jump, and lose your mind through surreal levels packed with brainrot humor, crazy visuals, and unpredictable madness. Enjoy custom sound effects and music that match each character’s bizarre personality!

title: Bffs Spring Break Fashionista
description: Welcome to the Bffs Spring Break Fashionista. Spring break is here. Barbie and their friends are can’t wait to have some fun together. They’ve been waiting for the spring break since the beginning of the year. Help them prepare their spring break outfits! They can finally wear skirts and dresses since it’s really warm outside now, so make sure to create a cute look! Have fun!

title: Fish Story 3
description: Welcome to Fish Story 3! Immerse yourself in 4,000+ levels of Match 3 excitement guided by our mermaid host. Solve puzzles, conquer Daily Missions, and unlock treasures in the Daily Challenge. Dive into addictive challenges and return daily for rewards. Join the underwater adventure now!

title: Ultimate Sports Car Drift
description: Dive into the world of Ultimate Sports Car Drift and feel the rush of adrenaline as you take on the ultimate drifting challenges. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to the world of drift racing, this game offers something for everyone. Buckle up, hit the gas, and let the drifting madness begin!

title: School Teacher Game School Day
description: Enter the world of teaching in School Teacher Simulator! Manage classrooms, inspire students, and experience the daily challenges of education. Plan lessons, grade assignments, and engage with students to create a dynamic learning environment. Customize your teaching style and watch as your students grow and learn. Are you ready to become the ultimate educator?

title: Idle Lawnmower
description: In Idle Lawnmower, embrace the tranquility of tending to your virtual lawn, earning gold with each satisfying swath cut. Utilize your earnings to upgrade your lawnmower, enhancing efficiency and earning potential in this idle game of grassy growth and financial gain.

title: Street Racing: Moto Drift
description:
Become the king of drifting! Win extreme street motorcycle races, escape from the police and make your way to victory!

**Feel the extreme and drive:** Incredible motorcycle races, chases, drifting and crazy stunts are waiting for you. Feel the drive, enjoy the speed, make exciting drifts and win the race!

**Avoid the chase:** Beware of the police who are trying to catch you!

title: Push Them!
description: Push Them! is a shooting game where your goal is to push the annoying red stickmen to fall into the water.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

title: Fast Lap
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed racing with a simple yet challenging touch-controlled game. Navigate a twisting track as you balance speed and control. Accelerate on straightaways, but be careful! Take curves too fast and you'll spin out. Master the art of timing to become the ultimate racer.

title: Geometry Vibes
description: Geometry Vibes is a reaction-based arcade game where you avoid obstacles, traps and spikes that come at you in waves. Your goal in the game is to keep your arrow on the route and take it as far as possible. The game includes a classic mode with levels, a race mode (2-3-4 players) where you can do multiple races, and an endless mode where you can test yourself! Geometry Vibes, where the excitement never ends, invites you to challenge...

title: Doge Bubble
description: Doge Bubble is a classic bubble shooter game with multiple challenging levels. Doge Bubbles features the classic bubble shooter gameplay with 3 powerups: The rocket that clears the chosen path, the bomb that clears up to 8 bubbles at a time and the multi color bubble. The goal in each level is to "free" all the doge bubbles.

title: Stolen House
description: Stolen House is a free leisure online game for boys. You play the role of a thief in the game, and you need to steal the specified items to complete the task. There are many dangerous things to pass the levels, so you need to avoid traps and obstacles, and don't be found by guards. The game is exquisite and the gameplay is simple. Come and challenge to unlock more levels!

title: Plane Crash Ragdoll Simulator
description: As a fearless pilot, your mission is simple: survive a relentless onslaught of rockets targeting your aircraft. Take the controls of a variety of planes and helicopters, each with unique skins to unlock and customize. Your goal is to navigate through perilous skies and bring your aircraft to the ground without crashing. But be warned: if you touch the ground, your aircraft will be exploded!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Hidden Object: Emily's Case
description:
A detective adventure set in Victorian London.

Search for hidden objects, uncover clues, and investigate the disappearance of a young girl. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, and step by step reveal the secrets of the old city.

title: High Speed Crazy Bike
description: Get ready to take on the ultimate mud dirt bike racing challenge as you barrel through rough terrain at breakneck speeds, using your skills and quick reflexes to navigate through a myriad of obstacles and emerge victorious in this adrenaline-fueled test of skill and daring.

title: Soul Not Found
description: Soul Not Found is an idle-incremental game with an undead army and battle theme.  Story The necromancer who has just lost the great war is ready to rebuild his armies and fight his way back to the top.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Pocket Parking
description: Get all the cars out of the parking lot wthin the time limit! The car goes straight forward and backward. Move it in a direction where there are no walls or cars.

title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
description: Want to begin a fun and relaxing fishing adventure? In Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter, you’ll become a fishing master. Use your skills and quick reflexes to catch various fish while enjoying a laid-back casual experience!

title: ASMR Washing & Fixing
description: This game is one of the cleaning games that gives you a real experience like no other. Most of the cleaning and organizing games on the market are 2D, but this game brings you a 3D experience. At the beginning of the game, you can pick a cool tool. There are 5 levels in this game and you can pick a level to start your cleaning. You can move your position as well as use the cleaning tool by clicking on the buttons on the screen or by hitting the keyboard.

title: Lovely Cat Pet Life
description: Call for all pet lovers! If you are a DIY enthusiast or enjoy playing with cute animals, join Lovely Cat: Pet Life, a casual DIY cat game online. Dive into this adorable, fun-filled, and creative game that combines the elements of cats, pets, fashion, and DIY all in one perfect package! Play dress-up game: Try out charming suits on your pet. Decorate an ideal look for your kitten. Enjoy minigames unblocked: Join mini animal parkour games with your little cat.

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Slinky Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing color-therapy game where you sort bright slinky rings into matching stacks. Easy to play yet surprisingly challenging, it’s perfect for calming down while keeping your brain active. Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful levels, and satisfying logic puzzles.

title: Kiss O Neck
description:
Kiss O Neck: Stretch, Kiss, and Laugh Out Loud
Each level brings a new, funny, and totally unexpected situation.
You never know what’s going to happen when you stretch that neck a little further

title: Russian Derby Crash
description:
Russian Derby Crash is a thrilling game that immerses you in the atmosphere of spectacular car racing with elements of destruction. You'll control one of five Russian cars or a tank. Destroy cars on the training ground and unlock new ones!
This game has a unique twist: in addition to cars, there's a tank on the training ground, from which you can shoot at other participants!

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Dot by Dot
description:
Dot By Dot is a relaxing puzzle game where you have to connect dots into lines and get amazing drawings. Once you connect all the dots and lines, the drawing will be automatically colored! Enjoy the addictive puzzle game!
Let the Dot by Dot game develop your creativity and skills. Draw a line, connect colored dots and see what kind of drawing you get.

title: Hidden Objects Bakery
description: Explore 6 charming bakery shops in this fun hidden object game! With 24 exciting levels, find 6 hidden bakery items in each shop before time runs out. Perfect for all ages, enjoy the challenge and discover delicious treats in every corner. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: TimeWarriors
description: Time Warriors is a strategy game where you lead your army through history, from the Stone Age to futuristic battles. Upgrade your troops, build powerful bases, and use unique units and tactics to defeat your enemies.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: 1010 Elixir Alchemy
description: Enter the enchanting world of '1010 Elixir Alchemy', where strategic placement reigns supreme. Strategically place Tetris-style blocks on a 10x10 grid to collect Elixirs. Complete rows or columns to gather Elixirs. If the grid fills up with remaining Elixirs, it's game over. With 60 levels, master the art of alchemy in this addictive adventure!

title: Traitor Beaver!
description: Beaver Traitor! An exciting game where one player takes on the role of the traitor, while the other players act as regular participants. Your goal as the traitor is to secretly kill all the other players, sabotaging their tasks at the nuclear power plant. You'll need to be cunning, careful, and think strategically to avoid detection and achieve victory. Use various tactics and deception to reach your goals.

title: Tower Defense Dragon Merge
description: Experience Tower Defense: Dragon Merge, a thrilling clash of strategy and chaos for hours of unique gameplay. Spin for PowerUps in the in-game shop, expanding your arsenal as you level up to combat invaders. In the frenzy of the alien assault, mash the cannon button for more firepower. Reinforce castle walls and fortify defenses through upgrades for a fighting chance against the relentless onslaught. Face the challenge, strengthen your defenses, and enjoy an exciting blend of strategy and chaos!

title: Balloon Pop Frenzy
description:
Balloon Pop Frenzy is a fun and fast-paced tap game where you pop balloons for points!
Tap normal and gold balloons to score, but avoid the tricky skull balloons!
With vibrant visuals, increasing difficulty, and simple controls, it's perfect for quick, casual play on any device.

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Tile Sort - Match 3
description: Tile Sort - Match 3 is an addictive match-3 puzzle game where your task is to sort and match identical tiles on the board. The game combines classic match-3 gameplay with elements of sorting, adding an extra layer of strategy and logic. Move tiles, creating combinations of three or more identical tiles to clear the board.

title: Pet Fall
description: You can move animals from side to side. You have to collect full horizontal lines to make them disappear. Some animals are frozen and must be released twice, some are locked in cages and cannot be moved. Use bonuses when necessary

title: Medieval Escape
description: Medieval escape is a adventure escape game where you must search for useful items in the rooms to help you escape. Look carefully around the rooms, and use your logic to solve the riddles. Find your way to escape!

title: Master Blender
description: Becoming the Strongest Bartending Master！Tap the bottle lightly to pour water. Organize the water so that each bottle's water is distributed to the corresponding colored cup!

title: Powerful Punch
description: Ready to let off some steam? Powerful Punch is the perfect game to brighten your day and release your frustrations. Rescue the weak, take down villains, and unleash your spooky punch, sprunky punch, or even a spranky punch in levels filled with surprises and hilarity

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Get ready for intense action in Turbo Race 3D! Upgrade your car’s speed, acceleration, grip, and brakes to dominate the competition. Use shields and boosters to gain an edge, and customize your ride with decals and colors. Race through 3 exciting worlds—city, desert, and snow—while evading traffic and outpacing opponents on thrilling highways. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate racer?

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description: MineTap Merge Clicker is an idle clicker that combines merge mechanics with crafting and adventure. Dive into a pixelated world where you mine resources, craft powerful gear, and battle zombies and other monsters.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Rummy Classic
description:
Experience the timeless gameplay of Classic Rummy, where your strategic skills and sharp thinking will be put to the test. Form sets and runs to create winning combinations and declare your victory!

Be the first player to put all your cards on the table in one or more times to win a round. The score of cards still in the hands by other players will be awarded to the winner of the round.
Will you be the player to first reach 200 points and win the game? Can you beat our challenging AI opponents?

title: Stick Hero Fight
description: Enter the most nervous stickman battles. In Stick Hero Fight, you as a mighty stickman hero. Fight through waves of enemies using incredible battle skills. This action game lets you upgrade your hero and unleash devastating attacks to dominate every fight! Use punches, weapons, and powerful skills to deliver deadly attacks.

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Obby Toilet Line
description:
Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end.

This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn.

title: Crazy Screw King
description: This is Unscrew All! More than simple matching, swiftly remove screws into same-colored bins. Glass slides down with each success! Release stress, show skill, become the Screw Master!

title: Palkovil The Way Home
description: Explore the magical world of Palkovil! Battle monsters, solve puzzles, collect toys, and uncover secrets. Feed pets, defeat bosses, and save the New Year in this festive adventure. Dive into quests and bring the Christmas tree home in this exciting online game!

title: The Lost City - Match 3
description:
Hit three in a row and get a crazy field explosion!
Use colorful booster effects that will make the game even more fun and colorful!
No stressful time restrictions! Enjoy the adventure freely!
Go through a wide selection of mysterious and mystical stages.
Complete various levels and get happiness from breaking gems!

title: Beach Club
description:
Calm down and manage your Beach Club!
Relax while listening to the waves, the ocean and some gulls. And soon you'll feel like you're floating around at the beach...
Let your helpers do all the work, stroll through the sand and collect the money from your customers.
Unlock new stuff so that even more people will come to your beach :D

Buy more seats, expand your beach and build your own empire!
Get some clean towels and make your Beach Club the most beautiful place.

title: Forest Glade Mysteries
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Forest Glade Mysteries — a magical forest where the cutest animals live! Each level introduces you to new fluffy friends and exciting challenges. This forest is full of mysteries, and every step brings you closer to uncovering ancient secrets!

title: Delta Force Airborne
description:
This game offers a whole new level of graphics and sound design that completely immerses you in a realistic atmosphere of battles. 
Shoot and use tactical thinking to overcome obstacles and achieve victory together with your team. 
Explore a variety of maps, each of which is full of unique opportunities and strategic points.
Become a master of team play by coordinating with your teammates and using different character classes to create the perfect strategy.

title: i8 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning supercar through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Water Junk Warriors
description: Water Junk Warriors is a vibrant eco-adventure game where players dive into polluted waterways to clean up human-made junk and restore the natural balance of riverbanks, beaches, and urban canals. Armed with clever tools and a passion for nature, players collect floating trash, unlock animated milestones, and witness the environment come back to life, one subgoal at a time.

title: Doge Match
description: Welcome to Doge Match, a delightful and addictive puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! With 36 meticulously crafted levels, Doge Match offers a unique and challenging experience for players of all ages.

title: Agar.io
description: Agar.io is the original .io grow game. Play as a simple agar cell fighting to become the largest cell in a multiplayer game arena.
genre: Grow, Grow99, 2D1,175, Collect600, idle, Browser Game

title: Cyberpunk: Corporation
description:
The corporation takes control of the city. You are the only one who can fight back and free the inhabitants.
Enlist the support of local residents by completing their tasks. Activate the robot and break through the defense line.

title: Merge 2048 Cake
description:
Merge 2048 Cake is a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where you merge matching tiles to create higher numbers!
Combine three or more identical tiles to form a new one with double the value. Plan your moves, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and aim for the ultimate 2048 tile!
Enjoy smooth gameplay, vivid visuals, and a cozy, casual vibe that’s easy to play and hard to put down.

title: Water Dig Rescue
description: Dive into the captivating world of "Water Dig Rescue," a physics-based puzzle game where strategy and water manipulation go hand-in-hand. Players carve their way through sand to guide streams of water, aiming to fill a waiting truck at each level's end. With a touch of ingenuity and the laws of physics, can you solve the puzzles and achieve a triumphant splash?

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Tap To Color: Painting Book
description:
Unleash your inner artist and paint your stress away with Tap to Color: Painting Book Game! Dive into a vibrant world of color where creating a masterpiece is as simple as a single tap. Forget the mess of crayons and paints; this is the ultimate digital coloring book for all ages.

Find your calm and enter a state of flow as you bring beautiful illustrations to life. It’s the perfect way to relax after a long day, pass the time on your commute,

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle
description: A Revolutionary Jigsaw Experience. Each level, one image is randomly selected and split into 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, or 6×6 pieces, then completely shuffled. Your goal is simple: restore the picture by placing every piece in its correct position. But this is no ordinary jigsaw. When two neighboring pieces are placed correctly next to each other, they merge into a single movable cluster. Instead of slow, one-by-one placement, you can drag any piece or merged group onto another to instantly swap positions.

title: Hotel Manager
description:
Have you ever dreamt of being one of the biggest landowners in the world?

Get your (virtual) chance in this extremely addictive game!

Build hotels all over the world, upgrade them and crowd your opponents out of the market, leaving their customers to come to you!

title: Merge Cube Challenge
description: Merge Cube Challenge offers a unique 2048 experience with its innovative endless mode. You can play alone or compete with your friends. Also, test your strategy and quick thinking skills by competing against the CPU. In endless mode, try to get the highest score by using the bomb special power. With the excitement increasing with each move, collect points and leave your opponents behind! Are you ready to immerse yourself in this excitement?

title: Stickhole.io
description: "Stickhole.io" is a thrilling game with single and two-player modes. In single player, swallow stickman and defeat bosses within time limits. In two-player mode, compete to eat the most stickman, then battle with collected characters. Dynamic gameplay and colorful graphics make it addictive and fun.

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Pumpkin Catcher
description:
Fly on a jetpack between walls and avoid rotating traps. Catch pumpkins using your favorite monster: zombie, vampire, devil or even a cat!

Try this challenging Halloween game and set a new world record in catching pumpkins. Compete with your friends on the online leaderboard! Collect them all!

title: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game
description: Money Factory is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

title: Emoji Match
description: the emoji match includes dozens of different emojis. you can increase or decrease the number of pieces of these puzzles as you wish. so you can make it suitable for all ages. you can have a pleasant time by having fun and exercising your brain. come on we are waiting for you.

title: iTileZen sort puzzle
description: iTileZen Sort Puzzle  is a fresh and addictive puzzle game that blends the strategic color sorting mechanics with the satisfying tile-matching gameplay. Moves  colorful tiles to complete objectives before time runs out! Whether you love logic puzzles or fast-paced matching challenges, this game offers the best of both worlds.

title: Tricky Shots
description: This game is about you trying to make the best possible shot. Click and or tap on the marble to begin the aim and drag back for power. Release to shoot.

title: Banana Bounce!
description:
Banana Bounce! ? is a side-scrolling game where you lead your banana to as far as you can.
Discover many cool ? and amazing ? powerups to boost ? your progress!
Discover unique ? characters and earn coins ? while you run!
Don't forget to upgrade ⬆️ your powerups to make them even stronger ? and better!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Strawberry Hero
description: Stick your fork and climb to the top! Hold down to keep sticking the fork continuously. If your fork hits a hero or an obstacle, it’s game over! Stick the fork just above the falling hero’s feet to trigger a Super Jump and earn a high score!

title: Cosmic Dash
description: Jump into Cosmic Dash – an endless space runner full of speed and challenges! Dodge debris, break through asteroids, and gather tokens as you race across the solar system. Use boosts, shrinks, and jumps to chase high scores and experience thrilling interplanetary action!

title: Monster School 3
description: Continuation of the Monster School series from the creators of Noob vs Pro games. Teacher gave the school students a new challenge, this time the monsters will have to draw to survive!

title: Angry Flappy
description: "Angry Flappy is a fast-paced twist on the classic game, where players not only navigate through obstacles but also shoot bullets to destroy enemies and barriers. Get ready for an action-packed flying adventure!"

title: Scoop Tower
description: Scoop Tower is an addictive hyper-casual 3D ice cream stacking game where you build the tallest dessert tower possible. Drop scoops with perfect timing, balance your tower, and stop it from falling. Earn “Perfect” drops to trigger Fever Mode and beat high scores. Face tricky wind gusts, challenge friends, or enjoy relaxing endless stacking fun anytime.

title: Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
description:
Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
Swipe fruits, blast combos & solve hundreds of juicy match-3 puzzles! Fun for all ages with vibrant graphics, daily rewards, offline play & no time limits. ?? Perfect for quick play or long sessions. Match, crush & enjoy!

Play now and test your brain!

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

Race through thrilling tracks in your speedy car! Collect gears to charge up your booster and unleash a powerful speed burst.
Upgrade your car to unlock better performance and purchase the fastest vehicles to dominate the competition.
Use the super boost to knock opponents off the track, climb the leaderboard, and prove you're the ultimate racer.
Beat the clock and challenge your friends online!

title: Association - Connect Word
description: Dive into the world of word puzzles and associations! In this game, you need to find hidden connections between words and group them logically. Each level offers new themes, new words, and increasingly challenging tasks. The game develops thinking, expands vocabulary, and trains attention. Intuition and logic will help you complete dozens of levels, from easy to hard, and become a true master of associations. Play at your own pace without time limits and use hints if needed.

title: Brainrot Ice Truck
description:
Step into the wild world of Brainrot Ice Cream, where over-the-top characters and ridiculous chaos blend perfectly with sweet, frozen treats!
Run your own ice cream truck, serving unhinged yet oddly charming customers with outrageous flavor combos, absurd toppings, and just the right amount of brain freeze.
Customize your setup, upgrade your gear, and keep up with the madness as each day gets weirder than the last.
Can you scoop fast enough to satisfy this wonderfully deranged crowd?

title: Car Parking Stunt Games 2024
description: Play the new challenging car game on Impossible Tracks in car stunt games 3d of 2024. Join the world of real impossible tracks in car racing games. Experience the real car parking stunt game with no limits of enjoyment. Are you a fan of Hard Parking Games 2024.

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Mole Dig Clicker
description: Help the mole dig to the center of the world! Tap to break dirt, buy upgrades, and watch your mole gear up. Mining continues while you're away. How deep can you get?

title: 2248 Block Merge
description: Upon beginning to play, you will undoubtedly become hooked on these 2048 puzzle games. They are crafted with stunning visuals and user-friendly gameplay, making them an excellent option for enthusiasts of number block puzzle games.

title: Fish Land Fish World
description: Explore a colorful underwater world full of fishing excitement. In Fish Land - Fish World, you’ll become a fishing expert in this relaxing idle fishing adventure! This game combines simulation and fishing elements. Allow you to fish, expand your pond, and grow your aquatic world.

title: Forest Tiles
description: There are several coins on the 9 by 9 playing field. It is necessary to place the blocks on the playing field in such a way as to completely assemble a vertical or horizontal line. Gold coins can be used to reset unnecessary blocks and continue the game if you lose.

title: Last Day On Earth Survival
description: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation game. In this large ruined city, you have 51 locations to discover. When you collect some wood and metal, you can make weapons on the Workbench. When you win enough experience and level up, you can check your Attribute and upgrade HP, ATK, Speed, and Search. In the day, explore and go to places you have never visited. I hope you will survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations.

title: Mojicon Spring Connect
description:
The 5th Mojicon game is here! Relax and enjoy the peaceful Spring season. Guided by your cheerful and cheeky Bunny companion, embark on a soothing puzzle journey to bring a barren landscape back to life. Match tactile spring tiles to clear the board and earn rewards!

Restore the Meadow: Follow a heartwarming story.
Collect Cards: Find 34 beautiful "Spring Wisdoms".
Relax: Enjoy classic tile-matching mechanics.
Achievements: Go for 100% completion!

title: Kick and Ride
description: Kick and Ride is a physics-based puzzle game consisting of two game modes. Drag and drop the block to make path for the soccer as well as for the vehicle. Enjoy the vibrant and colorful beach themed game.

title: OMG Word Rainbow
description: Step into the vibrant world of OMG Word Rainbow, an engaging word finder game illuminated by the beauty of the rainbow. Explore a colorful mosaic of letter tiles, where drawing lines along neighboring letters unveils words inspired by the enchanting spectrum of colors; enhance your journey with rewarded ads, allowing players to effortlessly skip levels in this captivating linguistic adventure.

title: Slingshot Chicken
description: Launch your fearless chicken from a slingshot and smash through unstable pig-filled towers in an endlessly fun physics adventure! With infinite levels and constantly evolving challenges, no two runs are ever the same. Perfect your aim, trigger explosive TNT chain reactions, and watch satisfying collapses unfold as you clear every pig before your shots run out. The fun never stops — how far can you go?

title: Horse Racing Derby Quest
description: Become a horse jockey and win the intense derby races against other jockeys.Release DateMarch 2018 (Android)November 2018 (iOS)November 2019 (HTML5)DeveloperPlaytouch developed Horse Racing Derby Quest.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Stack Tower Pro
description: Test your precision in this addictive 3D block stacking game! Build the tallest skyscraper, unlock stunning themes, and master the art of balance. Can you reach the stars?

title: Cyberpunk City Fashion
description: Belle, Ariel, Moana, and Elsa are willing to give up their stunning princess dress and have the full cyberpunk experience in this online dress-up game for girls. Surrounded by futuristic neon lights, the royal BFFs wait for you to join the fun and help them decide on the winning looks. Are you ready to join them in the Cyberpunk City Fashion game?

title: Stickman Shooter Bros
description:
Stickman Shooter Bros
Ready for action? Choose one of your 3 stickman characters with different powers and defeat your enemies with 4 different weapons.
Melt your enemies with the lava gun, destroy them with the minigun, deal damage from close range with the shotgun, and stun them with the teslagun.
Strong enemies, challenging bosses, and exciting levels await you.
Stickman Shooters is an immersive top-down shooter game.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Vex Hyper Dash
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced challenge in this brand-new Vex spin-off: Vex Hyper Dash! Inspired by the legendary Geometry Dash. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible. Jump from platform to platform, time your moves perfectly, and avoid the countless dangers that stand in your way. One wrong move, one mistimed jump, and it’s game over. 

Vex Hyper Dash puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Can you master the flow and set a new high score?

title: ColorWars.io
description: ColorWars.io is a competitive multiplayer strategy game where players battle for territorial dominance. Expand your color by painting the arena, manage a real-time gold economy to deploy defensive structures, and eliminate rivals by targeting their trails. Balance aggressive expansion with tactical defense to climb the global leaderboard.

title: Merge the Coins USSR!
description: ● Game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where coins fall and are connected if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Block Color Puzzle Blast
description: Immerse yourself in the explosive fun of Block Color Puzzle Blast, a thrilling puzzler where strategic block placement is key. Drag and drop vibrant blocks to fill gaps, unleash combos to earn massive scores, and experience the satisfying blast as completed lines clear the board, challenging you to reach new heights in colorful puzzle mastery.

title: Samurai Legacy
description: Samurai Legacy is an intense samurai action game with mixed RPG elements. In this game, you play as Nobunaga, a former legendary samurai who fights his way through the catacombs of the Ripper to save the world from the lord of shadows.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker
description: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker is a clicker game where you will manage your own club. Do some clicks to earn money, upgrade abilities to increase efficiency, defend your club from zombie attacks, get resources, and become a club tycoon!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Zombie Defense: War
description: Progress through the different environments and defend the last sanctuaries of humanity! Merge your towers and use boosters to bolster your chance of success.

title: Bunny Boy Online
description: Play the exciting online game. Variety of weapons, grenades, maps to choose from, various game modes, dynamic gameplay. Play with friends to the game!

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Deep Fishing
description: Dive into the fun with Deep Fishing! Explore the deep blue, cast your line, and reel in a variety of exciting fish species. Upgrade your gear, unlock rare catches, and become the ultimate fishing legend! Easy to pick up, but hard to put down – can you score the rarest fish and show off your skills?

title: Block Builder Jam
description: Block Builder Jam is a physics-based puzzle game that blends logic with creativity. Your goal is to drop blocks and fit them into the outlined shape on the screen. Each block falls according to real physics, so precision and timing matter. As levels progress, shapes become more complex and demand sharper planning. With its simple mechanics and engaging challenges, Block Builder Jam offers a satisfying mix of strategy and experimentation.

title: Zombie Driver
description:
Zombie Driver features: - multiple cars - upgrades - multiple levels - fun gameplay
Personalize your car by changing its weapon or its armor. Also, you can buy new car models in the store. Kill all zombies in your way, gather as

title: Egg Farm
description:
Join the egg-citing adventure of Egg Farm and unleash your inner fox as you embark on a fast-paced egg-catching frenzy! 
Dash with lightning agility, master obstacle evasion, and craft a fox character like no other with a range of custom skins. It's time to become an egg-cellent egg-catching maestro - your prowess will earn you legendary status!

title: Christmas Find The Differences
description: Get into the festive spirit with Christmas Find The Differences, the ultimate holiday-themed puzzle game! Test your observation skills as you compare two seemingly identical pictures filled with Christmas cheer. Spot all the differences in magical settings featuring Christmas trees, snowy landscapes, stockings, and Santa himself!

title: Fun IQ Puzzle
description: Fun IQ Puzzle is a vibrant and engaging logic game that test your problem-solving skills with colorful bubble-based puzzles. In Story Mode, we have to unlock locked spaces by placing colorful puzzles in the right spots. In Time Attack Mode, we have to race against the clock to solve puzzles as quick as possible. Challenge yourself to master every stage with this fun puzzle game!

title: Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle
description:
Step into the cozy world of Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle and let your mind unwind.
This calming puzzle game combines three favorite mechanics — Find, Sort, and Match — wrapped in a charming witchy atmosphere.

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

title: Wacky Wheels
description:
? Wacky Wheels – Drift, Dodge & Dominate!
Master the chaos in Wacky Wheels, the ultimate test of timing and control!
Navigate wild tracks, drift through tight turns, dodge massive hammers, and collect stars — all before the clock runs out. Each level brings new challenges, themes, and physics that’ll keep you on the edge of your seat.

? It’s not just a race — it’s a wacky adventure of skill and speed!

title: Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker
description: Planet Evolution: Idle Clicker is an idle game where you build your own planet the way you like! It is an easy-to-learn, simple, and relaxing idle game in which you can decorate and build your own unique planets in different areas of the universe with beautiful objects.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Island Puzzle: Build & Solve
description: Welcome to the ultimate Island Puzzle adventure! Test your logic and strategy skills in this captivating logic puzzle and building game.

title: Royal Kitchen: The Lost King
description:
In a lost kingdom, disaster has struck! During a knight’s tournament, a mysterious figure in a black cloak suddenly appears. The stranger casts a spell on the king, causing him to vanish without a trace right before everyone’s eyes!

The princess manages to escape from the castle, but where should she go now? How can she save her father and the entire kingdom? Will she be able to overcome all the challenges, find her father, and defeat the evil wizard?

title: Daily Match
description: Connect tiles with a great number of pictures in pairs within the limited time. As you crush all the tiles on the board, you can win the level! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology!

title: Idle Game Prison Life
description: Ever dreamed of running your prison? Now’s your chance! In this casual idle simulator, you’ll create a high-security prison empire. Upgrade and expand until you are on your way to becoming a tycoon! Create the perfect prison layout with cells, kitchens, gyms, and surveillance! Recruit guards, medics, and more to keep things under control.

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Chill Girl Clicker
description: Chill Girl Clicker is a soothing, laid-back clicker game that’s perfect for unwinding and finding your zen. Just like its predecessor, Chill Girl Clicker, this game offers a serene and calming experience, but with a delightful twist: a charming girl as the main character, bringing a fresh and enchanting vibe to your screen.

title: Balloon Match 3D
description: Relax and enjoy this addictive ballons 3d matching game as you collect items and complete different missions.Your goal is to clear the bubble by finding and matching all ballons before the time runs out!

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: Mahjong Slide Puzzle
description: Experience the thrill of Mahjong puzzles! Strategically match tiles, clear the board, and conquer challenging levels to achieve high scores!

title: Unicorn Find The Differences
description: Unicorn Find The Differences is a magical spot-the-difference game designed to test your observation skills and bring a bit of fantasy into your day! Each level offers beautifully crafted images with subtle differences that make every game exciting and engaging. Perfect for both kids and adults, this game is a delightful way to relax, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy charming unicorn illustrations. See if you can spot all the differences and reach the next level of mythical fun!

title: Skip Love
description: Ready for a funny, brain-teasing love adventure? Play an addictive brain teaser puzzle game in Skip Love. A funny little stickman hero trying to win the heart of his beloved while dodging all sorts of dangers! Each level has unique puzzles that make you think and laugh! Think and use your brain to overcome each challenge, helping the man overcome his sexy wife and lover. For example, help him disguise himself as a clown, disrupt, create chaos, etc.

title: Solitaires Crime Stories
description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the   mysteries of the town of Springdale!
    Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart.

title: Photo Block Journey
description: Move picture blocks across the board and place them in the right order to complete the image. Look carefully at the layout, plan your moves, and find the best way to solve each puzzle. The gameplay is simple from the first level: slide the tiles, open the path, and complete the picture.

title: Hotel Rush: Merge Story
description: Hotel Rush: Merge Story is a casual merge game where you join Ted on a journey to uncover his grandfather’s hidden past. As you explore the hotel’s forgotten corners, you’ll merge humble tools into powerful tools, uncover hidden treasures, and piece together family secrets that have been buried for years.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Through the Wall
description: Get ready for a unique puzzle experience with Through the Wall, where creativity and humor meet strategic problem-solving. Guide your stick figure character through moving walls by striking the perfect pose, with each level presenting new and exciting challenges.

title: Cyber Monday
description: Cyberpunk Monday thrusts you into a neon-drenched arcade cyberpunk adventure. Hack terminals, dodge digital foes, and race across futuristic CityGrid zones. Look for combos, outsmart AI, and collect cyber credits in this fast-paced hacking runner. Perfect for fans of cyberpunk games, arcade game thrills, free mobile games, and even cool math games that students love. Gear up—your Monday just got cyber.

title: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test
description: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test is a game where intelligence is everything! Boost your IQ by completing mini-games, taking on challenges, and battling in PvP duels.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Mr Long Hand
description: Immerse yourself in the quirky and delightful world of Mr Long Hand, where you take on the role of a stickman with incredibly long arms. Your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: use your elongated limbs to swing through obstacles, solve puzzles, and embark on thrilling rescues. Mr Long Hand offers a unique blend of creativity, challenge, and humor that is sure to captivate players of all ages.

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: "Hyper Cars Ramp Crash" is a 3D stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. You can perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great looking cars. 7 different super-sport car models are waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

title: Screw Masters 3D Puzzle
description:
Collect screws, take apart complex objects piece by piece, and test your puzzle-solving skills! Work your way through exciting levels, dismantle items down to the tiniest parts, and earn amazing rewards along the way. Use powerful bonuses to advance faster, beat challenging stages, and reach new heights.
Play, win, and share your best results with friends!

title: Smash the Car to Pieces!
description: Shoot the car with guns. Launch a combat drone or summon a tornado. Ram the car with a giant hammer or blow up all the windows with dynamite. There are many ways to destroy a car waiting for you in this game.

title: Peckshot
description: Stop the arrow at the right time and keep hitting the target. If you miss the target, the game ends. You can earn coins depending on the game results, and you can use the coins to get skins.

title: Magic Christmas Tree Match-3
description: Magic Christmas Tree Match-3 is a free New Year's match-3 game where you'll complete vibrant levels, create combinations of three or more, earn bonuses, and help the heroes decorate the festive town. Solve match-3 puzzles, combine elements, use power-ups, explosions, and super combos to complete tasks faster and advance the story.

title: SnakeMaxx
description: Dive into thrilling PvP battles or solo runs! Unlock avatars, skins, and boosters to power up your snake in this fast-paced action runner.

title: Drunken Fighters
description:
Are you ready for an adrenaline-filled fighting adventure?

Step into the ring in Drunken Fighters’ single-player mode and face opponents that will test your reflexes, or grab a friend and fight in two-player mode on the same device.

Master ragdoll physics and boost the thrill with Funny Mod options: Stretch Kick, Stretch Punch, Big Punch, Super Punch, and Big Head or let Random Mode surprise you with chaos!

title: Ninja Climb
description: Embark on a thrilling ascent in Ninja Climb, a captivating 2D game where your nimble ninja scales towering buildings. Click to seamlessly leap between structures, dodging obstacles along the way, and utilize rewarded video ads to revive when challenges arise, ensuring an adrenaline-packed ninja adventure.

title: Pet Connect Match
description: Pet Connect Match is an interesting matching game, in this game, you need to connect the same pets to eliminate all of them.  There are many different modes you can choose, you can pass levels, challenge time mode or just play without any limit. Have a good time!

title: Cute Coloring Games
description: Cute Coloring Games is a fun drawing coloring game. Filled with fun, colorful and creative drawing tools, coloring games help kids of all ages have fun creating art. Follow the prompts will draw and finish coloring it! Don't forget to share the success with your friends!

title: Traffic Run Puzzle
description: Traffic Run Puzzle is a popular car merge and racing simulator game. All Players can enjoy this game free online. Buy cars to merge, high-level cars can earn more money. Take it to the road to race, and watch out for other cars. Classic game-playing mode and car-driving content. Dear traffic cop, come to help them get through the intersection!

title: Road To 7
description:
Welcome to Road To 7, a fun casual math puzzle for everyone.
Start merging numbers from the starting point along the given path. Calculate adjacent digits with addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. All results must be non-negative integers between 0 and 9.
Finish merging all numbers and get 7 as the final result to clear levels. Sharpen your math and logical thinking in relaxing puzzle gameplay.

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Be the hero the world needs!
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

title: BlockBuster Puzzle
description: BlockBuster Puzzle is a Tetris-like game where you match colorful blocks so they disappear from the game screen. Unlock new realms and challenges as you progress, enjoying vibrant graphics and immersive gameplay.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Dessert DIY
description: Step into a sweet little food studio and craft desserts for hungry customers! Follow simple step-by-step recipes, pick the right ingredients, and assemble tasty treats exactly as requested. Satisfy each guest to earn coins, then spend your rewards in the shop to unlock more items, upgrades, and delicious options. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of colorful desserts!

title: Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a smart and fearless auction tycoon? Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator is an addictive auction and simulation game that puts you in exciting bidding wars to uncover hidden treasures! In this game, you join intense auctions for storage units, antiques, and mysterious items. Spot valuable gems, bid wisely, and sell them for huge profits! From small street auctions to luxury halls, build your empire step by step!

title: Slide Rabbit
description:
Swipe up, down, left, or right to move!
Don’t fall into holes or hit wolves or spikes, or it’s game over!
Avoid obstacles and eat as much food as you can!

title: Worms.Zone
description: Worms Zone is an Io arcade game where you join the fight to become the biggest worm. You must eat as much food as possible to grow bigger.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Tap Bead
description: Tap Bead is a relaxing puzzle game. Arrange beads by color to match patterns and clear levels. Simple controls, soft visuals, and many levels make it a soothing, satisfying experience.

title: Pew Pew Dose
description:
Build the weapon of your dreams and blast through hordes of cute… yet deadly zombie rascals!

Welcome to a bright and crazy post-apocalypse where only the most creative weapon makers survive. In this arcade 3D mayhem, you start with a simple gun… and end up wielding a monster built from multiple barrels twisted together into insane contraptions!

Craft without limits: attach barrel to barrel, add magazines, boost firepower, and create unique weapons that would make enemies run away…

title: Labo Brick Train Game For Kids
description: This is an assembly train game for all ages. Do you like small train toys? Have you ever wanted to assemble a beloved train by yourself? You can't miss our game if you are interested in all this.First of all, you need to pick out your favorite train style. Then start assembling the train from the locomotive, followed by the body.

title: Princesses at Horror School
description: In this game you will meet two charming monster girls who study at a school for young monsters. Every morning, the girls carefully think over their images, mixing elements of a classic princess and a creepy monster. Girls have different fashion preferences, but they have one thing in common - these two unusual girlfriends always attract the admiring glances of classmates. After all, they are not just princesses, but real monsters whose terrifying style makes even the bravest tremble!

title: Obby & Dead River
description: Dive into an exciting first-person 3D adventure in the style of Roblox! Your mission is to go through a dangerous path along the legendary river of death, connecting many large castles. Playing as a warrior, you will have to overcome thousands of kilometers, fight monsters and pirates, defeat dragons and get to the final boss.

title: HomeRun Derby
description: Step up to the plate and experience the excitement of Baseball's exhilarating Home Run Derby! Swing your bat and aim for the fences to hit as many home runs as you can. Time your swings carefully to score big points and keep the crowd cheering! How many home runs can you hit in a row? Test your skills and see if you can become the ultimate Home Run champion!

title: Math Lava: Tower Race
description: Test your math skills under pressure in Math Lava: Tower Race, a fast-paced Roblox style web game where quick thinking and accurate answers are your keys to survival. Answer math questions correctly to build blocks beneath you, racing against opponents and rising lava. The faster and more accurate you are, the higher you climb!

title: Burger Here
description: From a small restaurant to a burger empire! Serve customers, clean tables, hire the best staff and deliver orders on time. Make each burger a masterpiece that everyone will crave. Expand to 4 restaurants and attract more customers.

title: Flag Master: World Flags Quiz
description: Flag Master is the ultimate test of your flag knowledge and geography skills! Paint and recreate flags, solve jigsaw puzzles, guess capitals, match neighboring countries, and take on a variety of engaging challenges in a fun, fast-paced experience.

title: Obby Escape from Tsunami Brainrot
description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic Roblox-inspired action game inspired by the Obby genre, where every second counts. Outrun the oncoming tsunami, upgrade your speed and strength, collect resources, and survive the frantic pace.
Develop your base and Brainrot collection, earn currency even offline, and unlock new progression opportunities.

title: Relay Race
description: Relay race game is an engaging and addictive game that combines puzzle solving elements, casual gameplay and exciting race challenges. This game offers players a unique combination of fun puzzles and trolls for a thrilling and engaging gaming experience.

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
description:
Obby Highest Jump Ever is a click-based jumping and climbing game where every click makes you stronger. Start from a small 10M building and push your way up to massive 2500M towers as your jump power grows step by step. Each new height feels like a new milestone, and every rooftop trophy proves you earned it.

Your goal is simple: jump higher, reach the top, and collect trophies. The higher the building, the bigger the reward.

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Puzzle lub
description: In this puzzle game you need to connect the pieces in a line. To successfully complete the game, use its mechanics to your advantage.

title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
description: Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Stick Man Battle Fighting
